{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out refunded orders — only completed orders count as conversions
df_clean = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rates by channel
conversion_rate_email = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
conversion_rate_paid_search = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Compute the difference (email minus paid_search)
difference = conversion_rate_email - conversion_rate_paid_search

# Print each value exactly as they will appear in evidence
# We must print the raw numbers that will be in evidence
# Each number must be printed by code
print(conversion_rate_email)
print(conversion_rate_paid_search)
print(difference)"}
